model_annotations.English: Figure 5, titled "Performance of various RL methods with and without self-reflection," presents a bar chart comparing the performance of different reinforcement learning (RL) methods, both with and without self-reflection capabilities. The horizontal axis lists the RL methods: PPO, DPO, GRPO, and SRPO, each shown in two variants — with self-reflection (indicated by a checkmark) and without (indicated by a cross). The vertical axis represents performance, scaled from 0 to 1, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. Each method has two adjacent bars: the left bar corresponds to the version without self-reflection, and the right bar corresponds to the version with self-reflection. The bars are colored differently to distinguish between the methods — PPO is light blue, DPO is light green, GRPO is light orange, and SRPO is light purple. For all methods, the bar with self-reflection is visibly taller than the one without, indicating improved performance. Specifically, the performance values (approximate) are: PPO without self-reflection (~0.6), PPO with self-reflection (~0.75); DPO without (~0.55), DPO with (~0.7); GRPO without (~0.7), GRPO with (~0.85); SRPO without (~0.75), SRPO with (~0.9). The chart clearly illustrates that adding self-reflection consistently enhances performance across all RL methods, with SRPO achieving the highest performance when self-reflection is enabled.
